source_integrity.details: No real source-integrity checker exists yet (Member 2's component) -- 'passed: true' is asserted by construction (plain Maven, no instrumentation involved), not independently checked.

limitations: reproduction and victim_alone are REAL measured counts: od-fixture's F3 case was actually run 20 times each way via plain Maven on 2026-10-09 (eval/tools/run_real_reps.sh). F3 is deterministic given its full 3-test reduced sequence -- it reproduces every single time, not a flaky in-between rate. See docs/evidence-m3.md and eval/benchmark/logs/F3.json.

This is the two-polluter edge case: removing either single polluter (A or B) alone makes the victim pass again -- a one-by-one polluter search cannot find it, only a search that considers polluter combinations (W10, ADR-007).

resource_edges lists only the primary edge (Member 1's extractor reports one edge at a time; ADR-010 section 6/W21 is what lists every edge structurally). The schema's single polluter_write_location field cannot represent both of this case's two required writes (flagA and flagB); only the second write is shown here -- a known Iteration 1/2 limitation for multi-polluter cases.
bytecode_offset values (3, 7) are still placeholders -- no real static-bytecode-evidence extractor exists yet (Member 1's component).

Reduced by single-trial delta debugging; not deletion-verified (ADR-011, W20 not yet landed) -- especially relevant for a two-polluter case like this one, where neither polluter has been repeated-removal checked yet. assurance.sequence.deletion reports this as NOT_YET_CHECKED.
